definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of arranging flowers, emphasizing form, balance, and harmony.

examples.japanese: {生|い}け{花|ばな}を{習|なら}っている。
{玄関|げんかん}に{生|い}け{花|ばな}を{飾|かざ}る。
examples.english: To display a flower arrangement in the entrance.

examples.japanese: {生|い}け{花|ばな}の{展覧会|てんらんかい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to an ikebana exhibition.

notes:
{生|い}け{花|ばな} is one of the traditional Japanese arts alongside {茶道|さどう} (tea ceremony) and {書道|しょどう} (calligraphy).

MAJOR SCHOOLS:
- {池坊|いけのぼう}: oldest school
- {草月流|そうげつりゅう}: modern style
- {小原流|おはらりゅう}: naturalistic style

ALTERNATIVE READING:
{華道|かどう} is a more formal term for the art of flower arrangement.
